instructions: User directive 2026-10-27 (paper-focused comparison and ablation study): after the cs / w4 / cs+w4 campaign finishes, (1) reconcile the results and choose the paper setting: chlrm stays the pretraining recipe; choose the encoder architecture among the fully evaluated 2x2 candidates (chlrm, cs, w4, csw4) on the selected paper environments; select six environments if possible, otherwise four, on which the contribution over end-to-end DrM+CNN is clear and meaningful (task diversity, visibility, learning behaviour, consistent differences across seeds); weigh episode-return learning efficiency and final performance together, success and compute as supporting evidence; never choose from an isolated seed or evaluation point; describe the selection as performance-informed; keep the full eight-environment comparisons as supplementary material and use the same set for every baseline; freeze the architecture and the set before any new ablation. (2) Main comparison: evaluation episode-return curves (undiscounted return within an evaluation episode vs agent steps), 2x3 (or 2x2), all relevant baselines incl. DrM+CNN, matched budgets and all registered seeds, seed means with 95 % intervals, identical modest smoothing (raw data kept), return AUC / last-5 / final per task, success as supporting figures, per-environment reward scales, a fixed method-independent normalization for any aggregate; DrM protocol with proprioception; input privileges marked. (3) Qualitative and quantitative comparisons of the selected checkpoints: rendering (GT, ours, SinCro, SNeRL; PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS; robot / object / background crops; camera groups separate), synchronized rollouts from matched initial conditions at training and moving viewpoints (stated example-selection rule), t-SNE (one fixed expert demonstration per task; training-camera trajectories together; each moving / held-out trajectory separately with one training-camera reference; consistent sampling and projection), nearest-neighbour cross-view retrieval (quantitative and galleries, exported representations, common query / gallery protocol, no trivial self-matches), geometry and motion visualizations kept. (4) Training- vs moving-camera final success at exactly 1M agent steps on the selected environments, all compared baselines, paired drops within seed, uncertainty, negative drops kept, per-task episode-return drops separately, eight-environment version as supplementary. (5) Five matched ablations on one informative environment chosen and recorded before any ablation outcome (no InfoNCE; no motion loss; T=1 spatial reconstruction with chronological three-frame stacking at RL time; no explicit depth loss; no Chamfer), 200k pretraining, pretraining seed 0, frozen-encoder DrM 1M agent steps, RL seeds 2000-2002; reuse the exact full-method reference and any genuinely equivalent completed ablation; register before results; Codex review of implementation and fairness. (6) Paper-quality figures after reading the baseline papers and RSS representation / control papers (Voltron, 3D Diffusion Policy, Diffusion Policy); update the existing artifact in place within its file limit; no docs/ABLATION_PLAN.md.

supersedes.architecture_rule: the eight-task recommendation rule of runs/setup/encx-definition-20261026.json (recommendation_rule; reports/results-artifact/src/encx_rl.py decision()) - still computed and reported as history
supersedes.environment_set: the frozen six-task presentation set of reports/results-artifact/encx/env_selection.json (hammer, pick-place, coffee-push, door-open, peg-insert-side, peg-unplug-side) - kept as history

selection.nature: performance-informed selection: it uses the observed RL results of the candidates and of DrM+CNN; it is described as such wherever the selected setting is reported
selection.script: reports/results-artifact/src/paper_selection.py (written 2026-10-27 before the 2x2 campaign finished; dry run on the already complete chlrm and CNN rows only)
selection.runs_when: every candidate arm (chlrm, cs, w4, csw4) and DrM+CNN complete on all eight tasks with RL seeds 2000-2002 on the common grid 10k..1M (final.json present); never on partial data
selection.per_run_metrics: training-camera group (mean of the six training cameras at each evaluation): return AUC (mean of the 100 evaluations), last-5 (960k-1M), final (1M); success likewise; held-out and moving groups likewise for the robustness evidence

return_normalization.formula: nR = (R - R_random) / (R_expert - R_random), per task, fixed and method independent
return_normalization.references: reports/results-artifact/norm/screening/summary.json: scripts/screen_tasks.py (unchanged tool, --out outside docs/) 2026-10-27, 50 random-policy and 50 scripted-expert episodes per task, 125 agent steps, action repeat 2, the v3 reward summed per agent step (the evaluation protocol); coffee-push reproduces docs/task_screening exactly (random 10.56, expert 1121.07)
return_normalization.note: values above 1 mean more dense reward than the scripted expert (DrM policies often exceed it); per-task figures keep raw reward scales

selection.contrast_vs_cnn: for candidate A and task t: d_auc and d_last5 = difference of seed means of nR AUC / nR last-5; p_auc, p_last5 = share of the 9 cross-seed pairs (A seed i, CNN seed j) with A > CNN (ties count 1/2); ds_last5 = difference of seed means of training-camera success last-5; robustness r = mean over held-out and moving groups of the nR last-5 difference
selection.task_class: clear if ((d_auc >= 0.05 and p_auc >= 7/9 and d_last5 >= -0.05) or (d_last5 >= 0.05 and p_last5 >= 7/9 and d_auc >= -0.05)) and ds_last5 >= -0.10; parity if not clear and d_auc >= -0.05 and d_last5 >= -0.05; otherwise cnn_better
selection.eligible_tasks: method independent: not observation-flagged and not saturated in encx/env_selection.json (all eight pass)
selection.environment_set: evidence e = (d_auc + d_last5) / 2; >= 6 clear tasks: six (the best clear task of each skill family first, then by e); 4-5 clear tasks: four the same way; < 4 clear tasks: four - the clear tasks, then parity tasks by r (new family first), then the least disadvantaged remaining tasks by e - reported as a narrower scope with the number of clear tasks stated
selection.architecture: order: (1) number of clear tasks in the candidate's set; (2) mean e over the set, candidates within 0.02 of the best tied; (3) mean ds_last5; (4) mean r; (5) lower GFLOPs/frame; (6) simplicity chlrm, cs, w4, csw4
selection.reported_with_the_choice: every candidate on the chosen set (tradeoffs); per-task classes for all candidates; sensitivity (does not change the choice): margin 0.03 / 0.07, P 6/9 / 8/9, leave-one-seed-index-out (P 3/4); the historical eight-task encx decision and the historical six-task set
selection.freeze: the chosen architecture and environment set are written to paper/selection.json (--write) and recorded in docs/EXPERIMENT_LOG.md before any ablation row is registered

main_comparison.methods: the selected architecture (ours) and every existing baseline with complete eight-task results: DrM+CNN (end to end, random shift), SinCro, ReViWo, DynaMo, 3D-MVP B (single RGB-D + extrinsics, privileged), SNeRL (three posed RGB cameras, privileged), 3D-MVP A (three RGB-D + extrinsics, privileged); the historical original method and chlrm in supplementary panels
main_comparison.protocol: DrM with proprioception (env.proprio_indices [0,1,2,3]), 1M agent steps, RL seeds 2000-2002, evaluation every 10k agent steps (docs/RL_PROTOCOL.md)
main_comparison.curves: training-camera evaluation episode return (undiscounted sum of the per-agent-step reward within an evaluation episode, mean of the six training cameras x 20 episodes) vs agent steps; per seed, a centred moving average over 5 evaluations (50k agent steps; shortened at the ends) applied identically to every method; seed mean with a 95 % percentile bootstrap interval over the three seeds (B = 10,000, rng seed 0); unsmoothed values exported
main_comparison.tables: per task: return AUC, last-5 and final (raw scale) with seed mean and 95 % interval; nR aggregates (mean over the set, seeds resampled within task); success AUC / last-5 / final as supporting
main_comparison.layout: 2x3 (six tasks) or 2x2 (four tasks), per-task reward scale, shared legend

moving_camera_drop.step: exactly 1,000,000 agent steps (the evaluation row at step 1M, final.json present)
moving_camera_drop.groups: training cameras (train0..5) vs moving cameras (traj_lateral, traj_circular); cameras averaged within group, then the paired drop within each RL seed, then mean over seeds with a 95 % percentile bootstrap (B = 10,000)
moving_camera_drop.outputs: paired bars and drop bars on the selected set (all compared methods), per-task episode-return drops, eight-task versions as supplementary; negative drops kept; pending marked, never zero-filled

ablations.environment_rule: fixed now, applied after the freeze and before any ablation outcome: among the selected set, for the selected architecture A with its three RL seeds: eligible if training-camera success AUC >= 0.25, last-5 >= 0.30 and last-5 <= 0.92 (meaningful learning, not ceiling, not nearly unsolvable) and not observation-flagged; rank clear-advantage tasks (class clear vs CNN) first, then by headroom-to-noise h = min(success AUC, 1 - success last-5) / max(seed SD of success AUC, 0.03); if none is eligible in the set, apply the same rule to all eight tasks; record the choice in docs/EXPERIMENT_LOG.md before registering the rows
ablations.reference: the selected architecture's existing pretraining (seed 0, 200k) and its DrM rows (seeds 2000-2002) on that environment - reused, not rerun

arms.no_infonce: --set loss.invariance=0.0 (slot consistency 0.5, synthetic views, reconstruction and every other term unchanged; NOT configs/metaworld/ablations/no_infonce.yaml, which also sets consistency 0)
arms.no_motion: --set loss.motion=0.0 (explicit M3D weight only; three-frame encoder, displacement heads, temporal t1/t2 rendering, Chamfer at t1/t2 and synthetic renders unchanged; M3D is still computed, so the RNG stream matches)
arms.t1_spatial: configs/metaworld/variants/perframe_spatial.yaml appended (model.encoder.num_frames 1, model.decoder.motion_head false, temporal_branch false, model.perframe.temporal false): one shared single-image encoder with the selected stem / body; every frame of every training camera encoded and reconstructed independently at its own time with RGB, depth L1, coverage, Chamfer, the synthetic-view render and per-frame InfoNCE / consistency; no temporal reconstruction, no motion supervision; RL with vision.frame_features=stack: [E(I_t-4), E(I_t-2), E(I_t)] oldest first (policy feature 768 instead of 256; DrM projection Linear(768, 256), 263,680 instead of 132,608 parameters; repr_dim 256 unchanged; encoder temporal_embed shrinks by 256 parameters); newest-frame-only inference is not used
arms.no_depth: --set loss.depth_l1=0.0 (removes expected-depth L1 on both real and synthetic views - one key controls both; Chamfer 5.0, coverage 0.1 and every other term unchanged); labelled 'without explicit depth loss' because depth still supplies Chamfer target clouds, the coverage mask and other existing operations
arms.no_chamfer: --set loss.chamfer=0.0 (expected-depth L1 1.0, coverage 0.1 and every other term unchanged; depth_grad, depth_hard, visibility and occlusion stay 0; the skipped Chamfer block also skips its random draw)

ablations.verification: resolved configs (s4d.config.load_config) of each arm differ from the reference only in the listed keys; each row equals its reference row apart from names, the override and bookkeeping; a short smoke of t1_spatial with the selected stem / body (pretraining steps, export with policy_frames stack, DrM state 768) before registration; Codex review of the implementation and of the comparison's fairness
ablations.rows: per arm: 1 pretraining (200k, seed 0), 1 export, 3 DrM trainers (1M agent steps, seeds 2000-2002), 3 evaluators; a genuinely equivalent completed run (same resolved config, seeds, protocol) is reused instead of rerun and named in the log
ablations.analysis: each arm vs the reference on the ablation environment: training-camera episode return and success curves (as the main comparison), AUC / last-5 / final with seed means, 95 % percentile bootstrap intervals of the difference (seeds resampled within arm), held-out and moving groups reported separately; matched PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS and region crops on the same rendering protocol as the main comparison; geometry and motion diagnostics where defined (temporal metrics not applicable for t1_spatial); every arm reported, including small or unexpected effects; no environment switch after results

caveats_to_report: performance-informed selection of architecture and environments (selection uses the observed results)
3 RL seeds and 1 pretraining seed per arm and task; pretraining-seed variation unmeasured
three-seed percentile bootstrap intervals are coarse
baselines with privileged inputs (multi-camera, RGB-D, extrinsics) marked
the ablation environment is one task; ablation conclusions are limited to it
